questions.prompt: Should V0.10 be published to the public npm registry, or distributed only as GitHub source plus an installable release tarball?
questions.rationale: The distribution channel changes package metadata, release automation, credentials, provenance, and what BusinessAcceptance may claim.
options: Use GitHub source and an installable release tarball only; do not publish to the public npm registry (recommended)
Publish both a GitHub release and a public npm package

questions.prompt: Which public contact should SECURITY.md and the Code of Conduct use for private reports?
questions.rationale: A public open-source project needs a real reporting path and must not invent or publish an unapproved address.
options: Use the GitHub owner profile without publishing an email address

questions.prompt: Should main become the protected default branch for the public open-source preview?
questions.rationale: The release promotion boundary depends on a stable default branch and enforceable protection against unverified direct changes.
options: Use main as the protected default branch (recommended)
Keep the current release branch as the default without protection
